comparison.objective: Release a disc from a case hub, reorient it and insert it into a console slot.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual hub release, edge grasp, upright reorientation and slot insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Disc freed without dropping, aligned upright and centered, inserted deeply enough for drive capture. No material rubric detail missing.
comparison.reason: Tests coordinated release and precision insertion of one fragile object, not population separation.
